title.suggested: Former Saloon Partner of Tom Allen Injured in Memphis

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported from Memphis that railroad switchman James Kelly, who had been associated with Tom Allen, the fighter, in the saloon business in St. Louis, had his right arm amputated after an accident.

metadata.notes: Dispatch dated Memphis, August 21; page masthead too small to read in page.jpg, date taken from metadata.

facts.fact: James Kelly, a switchman later injured in Memphis, had been associated with Allen in the saloon business in St. Louis
